comment: The name holds 0x01. wintty.c tty_putstatusfield() prints it through putchar(), and patch 006 nomux_putch() drops a byte below 32 (and a high byte, the char being signed) from the captured screen while the cursor still advances, so the status row shows a blank there. ^X shows the name in a text window, and the quit's score line from topten.c shows it through raw_print().
